name: laolaoshiren/claude-code-skills-zh
description: A Chinese collection of 20 original development productivity skills, including code review, testing, documentation, dependency audit, and workflow helpers. The sample skill read covers a Chinese code reviewer. Draft scope is the 20 original skills in skills/ only. Tailored for Chinese language workflows.
install: Copy the skill directory into ~/.claude/skills/ (global) or project .claude/skills/ (README quick-install section). This is a copy route, not a pipe.
